2607.00926.title: Human-Machine Collaboration on Generative Meta-Learning: Model and Algorithm
2607.00926.paper_summary: Generalizing machine learning models to environments that differ from their training distribution remains a critical hurdle, particularly when data from the target domain is entirely or partially unavailable. We propose Generative Meta-Learning with Human Feedback (GMHF), a novel framework that bridges this domain gap by leveraging expert intuition to guide data synthesis. Grounded in a theoretical analysis of generalization error, we derive bounds demonstrating that aligning the distribution of generated data with human beliefs regarding the target physics significantly mitigates risk. GMHF operationalizes this insight by employing a Conditional Neural ODE (cNODE) as a generative digital twin, coupled with a Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent. The agent iteratively refines the latent physical parameters of the generated trajectories based on feedback, effectively steering the meta-learner toward the unobserved target distribution. Empirical validation on a nonlinear Duffing oscillator shows that GMHF substantially reduces deployment loss as expert reliability increases, and that the divergence between generated and target data falls under reliable feedback, directly corroborating the divergence-minimisation mechanism predicted by our theory. Further experiments on a non-dynamical probabilistic model confirm that the framework extends beyond ODE-governed systems, establishing human-AI collaboration as a rigorous catalyst for robust generalisation under distribution shift.
2607.00926.paper_summary_zh: 一般化機器學習模型以適應與其訓練分佈不同的環境仍然是一個關鍵障礙，特別是當目標領域的數據完全或部分不可用時。我們提出了帶有人類反饋的生成元學習（GMHF），這是一個新穎的框架，通過利用專家的直覺來指導數據合成，來彌補這一領域差距。基於對一般化誤差的理論分析，我們推導出界限，顯示將生成數據的分佈與人類對目標物理的信念對齊可以顯著降低風險。GMHF 通過使用條件神經常微分方程（cNODE）作為生成數字雙胞胎，並結合增強學習（RL）代理來實現這一見解。該代理根據反饋反覆精煉生成軌跡的潛在物理參數，有效地引導元學習者朝向未觀察的目標分佈。對非線性達芬 oscillators 的實證驗證顯示，隨著專家可靠性的提高，GMHF 顯著減少了部署損失，並且在可靠反饋下生成數據與目標數據之間的差異減少，直接證實了我們理論預測的差異最小化機制。對非動態概率模型的進一步實驗確認該框架超越了由常微分方程主導的系統，確立了人類與人工智能的合作作為在分佈轉移下實現穩健一般化的嚴謹催化劑。
2607.00926.author: Midhun Parakkal Unni et.al.
